_comment: GENERATED by tools/parse-map.py - do not hand-edit. Bank 5's world map, its room shapes and its room layouts.

regions.name: World map: 24 x 24 rooms
regions.description: 576 variable-length records, 24 rows of 24 - one per room of the labyrinth. A record is (first byte AND $0F) + 1 bytes ($8103: LDA ($16),Y / AND #$0F / SEC / ADC $16). $80F5 seeks through it; $8071 walks it as the player moves ($52 column, $53 row); $882D draws it on the status screen as 2x2-cell background tiles, sprites marking corridor entrances only. BYTE 0: low nibble length-1, $80 exactly empty, bit 4 = layout pointer present, bits 5-6 = room kind ($5D; $20 and $40 carry a sub-id). BYTE 1: low three bits = the KEY that reveals the cell ($04B0), bit 3 = the room has enemies, bits 7/6/5/4 = openings north/west/east/south ($82DD against the neighbours $E0/$E2/$E6/$E8), and byte 0 bit 7 puts a key door in an opening. BYTE 2: bit 7 = corridor entrance, low seven bits = corridor number. THEN, in order: sub-id ($5E), spawn script id ($57, into $A4C7), layout pointer. CHECKS: 370 of 370 non-empty records are exactly as long as their flags imply; corridor numbers 1-21 occur once each; in the labyrinth savestate the live room pointer $E4 = $8E4C is this walk's row 12 column 8, and that room's layout and openings match the nametable cell for cell; 211 rooms with enemies use script ids 1-47, 47 distinct. CORRECTION: this region was first 807 records running to $960E, proved by 'the walk lands exactly on $960F' - a weak test that a walk over arbitrary data passes about one time in four. The map ends at $91EA, which $8042 names as the room-shape base. Generated by tools/parse-map.py.

regions.name: Room shapes: 19 x 18 bytes, 1bpp
regions.description: 19 room shapes. $8042 computes $91EA + 18 * (A AND $1F), and $8278 shifts the 18 bytes out one bit at a time (CPY #$12) into the 16-wide room buffer at $0740 from index $20, writing the layout's fill tile wherever a bit is set: 144 cells, rows 2-10. THE EXTENT: the layouts use shapes 0-18, and 19 x 18 bytes from $91EA end exactly where the layout chain begins. Generated by tools/parse-map.py.

regions.name: Room layouts: 79
regions.description: 79 room layouts, read by $8243 through the pointer at the end of a map record. [shape | count << 5][fill tile], then count x [tile][position][six-bit mask | direction]: $82A3 walks the mask along a step from $82D9 (-15, 1, 16, 17 - up-right, right, down, down-right), writing the tile at each set bit. So a layout is 2 + 3 * count bytes. THE CHECK: chained from $9340 the layouts land exactly on $960F, and all 67 layouts the map points at are on the chain; 12 are not pointed at by any map record. Generated by tools/parse-map.py.
